name: encryption
description: Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) per-tenant envelope encryption for nSelf Cloud: AWS KMS, GCP Cloud KMS, and HashiCorp Vault Transit, with key rotation and an audit trail.
author: nself

actions.configure: Configure a KMS provider for the current tenant
actions.rotate: Rotate data encryption keys (re-wrap existing DEKs)
actions.status: Show current BYOK configuration and last verification
actions.key-events: List the key event audit trail

notes: This is a CLI-proxy plugin, not a service plugin: it has no port, no HTTP server, and no database tables of its own — it calls the BYOK plugin's own HTTP API (default http://localhost:3741). `nself plugin install encryption` must place the built nself-encryption binary at ~/.nself/plugins/bin/nself-encryption, where internal/plugin/router.go's ProxyCommand execs it for `nself encryption <args>` with stdio inherited. Extracted from cli/cmd/commands/encryption.go under CLI-R11 — a straight file move, since the command had zero github.com/nself-org/cli/internal/* dependencies before extraction.
